sections.heading: 24/7 Emergency Board Up Service in Alexandria
sections.body: Glass emergencies do not follow business hours, and neither do we. A smashed storefront, vandalized window, or accident-damaged glass door can happen at any time of day or night, leaving your property vulnerable. Our emergency board up team is on call 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including holidays, to respond to calls from property owners and managers across Alexandria. From the historic blocks near Old Town Alexandria to commercial corridors along Route 1, we dispatch experienced technicians who arrive prepared to assess the damage, measure the opening, and install secure boarding quickly. Fast response reduces the risk of secondary damage from rain, wind, or opportunistic trespassers, giving you immediate peace of mind while a permanent glazing solution is arranged.

We understand that a commercial client may need documentation for insurance purposes and that a homeowner simply needs their home secured before nightfall. Our team communicates clearly, works efficiently, and treats every property with the same level of professionalism and care. No job is too small or too urgent — we show up ready to help.

sections.heading: What Happens During an Emergency Board Up
sections.body: When you call us for emergency glass board up in Alexandria, our process is straightforward and designed to minimize stress. A technician is dispatched immediately and will contact you with an estimated arrival time. Upon arrival, the team assesses the extent of the glass damage, removes any loose or dangerous shards safely, and takes precise measurements of the affected opening. Sturdy boarding material is then cut to fit and securely fastened to prevent movement or displacement. We work carefully to avoid causing additional damage to surrounding frames, sills, or facades. Once the board up is complete, we walk you through the condition of the opening and discuss options for permanent glass replacement so you can plan your next steps with confidence.

sections.heading: Permanent Glass Replacement After Board Up
sections.body: A board up is an essential first step, but permanent glass replacement is the real solution. Once your property is secured, our team can schedule a follow-up appointment to install new glass for doors, storefront systems, windows, or curtainwall panels, depending on your property type. We work with commercial glass systems common in Alexandria office buildings and mixed-use developments near Potomac Yard, as well as traditional window and door glazing found in the city's many older residential properties. Our glaziers are experienced with a broad range of glass types and framing systems, and we bring the same quality workmanship to the replacement job as we do to the emergency response. You get continuity of service from one trusted provider.

faq.q: How quickly can you respond to an emergency glass board up call in Alexandria?
faq.a: We prioritize emergency calls and dispatch a technician as quickly as possible, typically aiming to arrive within a few hours of your call depending on location and current demand. Our team is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including weekends and holidays.

faq.q: Do you handle both commercial and residential board up jobs in Alexandria?
faq.a: Yes. We serve storefront owners, property managers, general contractors, developers, and homeowners throughout Alexandria. Whether you have a broken retail display window near King Street or a damaged residential window in Del Ray, we can help.

faq.q: Will you also replace the glass after the board up is complete?
faq.a: Absolutely. We offer full glass replacement services following an emergency board up. Once your property is secured, we can schedule permanent repair or replacement for windows, glass doors, storefronts, and other glazing systems.

faq.q: What should I do while waiting for your team to arrive?
faq.a: Stay away from broken glass and keep others clear of the area. If the break is in a high-traffic space, try to cordon it off safely. Do not attempt to remove broken glass shards yourself. Our technicians will handle debris removal safely when they arrive.
